children.title: EUDAT CDI Acceptable Use Policy and Conditions of Use | EUDAT
children.main_text: Scope This policy is applicable and must be accepted by the users of any EUDAT CDI services. Introduction This Acceptable Use Policy and Conditions of Use (“AUP”) defines the rules and conditions that govern your access to and use (including transmission, processing, and storage of data) of the resources and services (“Services”) as granted by the EUDAT CDI, represented by the EUDAT ltd, for the purpose of accessing and using distributed research data management services including storage resources, data processing facilities and the corresponding consultancy. Acceptable Use Policy and Conditions of Use (AUP) You shall only use the Services in a manner consistent with the purposes and limitations described above; you shall show consideration towards other users including by not causing harm to the Services; you have an obligation to collaborate in the resolution of issues arising from your use of the Services. You shall only use the Services for lawful purposes and not breach, attempt to breach, nor circumvent administrative or security controls. You shall respect intellectual property and confidentiality agreements. You shall protect your access credentials (e.g. passwords, private keys or multi-factor tokens); no intentional sharing is permitted. You shall keep your registered information correct and up to date. You shall promptly report known or suspected security breaches, credential compromise, or misuse to the security contact stated below; and report any compromised credentials to the relevant issuing authorities. Reliance on the Services shall only be to the extent specified by any applicable service level agreements listed below. Use without such agreements is at your own risk. Your personal data will be processed in accordance with the privacy statements referenced below. Your use of the Services may be restricted or suspended, for administrative, operational, or security reasons, without prior notice and without compensation. If you violate these rules, you may be liable for the consequences, which may include your account being suspended and a report being made to your home organisation or to law enforcement. Contact points The security contact for this AUP is: csirt@eudat.eu The administrative contact for this AUP is: cdi-secretariat@eudat.eu The privacy statements (e.g. Privacy Notices): Your personal data will be processed in accordance with the privacy statements ( Data Protection and Privacy Policies ) in compliance with the EU General Data Protection Regulation (2016/679). Applicable service level agreements: Reliance on the Services shall only be to the extent explicitly specified by applicable service description. EUDAT Ltd. c/o CSC - IT Center for Science Ltd. Documentation Welcome to the EUDAT Documentation service # EUDAT’s vision is Data is shared and preserved across borders and disciplines . Achieving this vision means enabling data stewardship within and between European research communities through a Collaborative Data Infrastructure (CDI) , a common model and service infrastructure for managing data spanning all European research data centres and community data repositories. On the EUDAT Document service you can find the documentation for the EUDAT B2 services suite, this includes all public user, technical and administrative documentation, and explains how to engage, deploy and use the services. The documentation is organised per service and type of audience (i.e. Users, Administrators, Developers). Documentation # Find research data, research data portal Store and publish research data Sync and share research data Register your instruments Register your research data with a persistent identifier Keep research data safe via data management policies Identity & authorisation Assign DOIs to your publications You can find more information on the individual services by clicking on the service names on the menu bar at the top or on the service icons links above. Feedback # Please contact us if you are missing any content or if you have general comments on EUDAT documentation. Interested in EUDAT services # If you are interested in an EUDAT service from the B2 services suite, you can find more information and/or request the services via the EUDAT Service Catalogue . Last update: 09.02.2024 Last review: 24.01.2025 Back to top

children.title: Data Protection and Privacy Policies | EUDAT
children.main_text: The following table of services with data privacy statement comprise CDI and non-CDI (client) services that are registered on B2ACCESS. It provides an overview not only of the CDI services, but of all the services that may receive user attributes from B2ACCESS. CDI Service CDI Service Description General Provider Privacy Statement B2DROP B2DROP is a secure and trusted data exchange service for researchers and scientists to keep their research data synchronized and up-to-date and to exchange with other researchers. EUDAT ltd & Juelich SC Data Privacy Statement B2DROP fi Community instance of B2DROP offered by CSC to members of finish universities. CSC Data Privacy Statement B2HOST JSC B2HOST resources provided by Jülich Supercomputing Centre. Juelich SC Data Privacy Statement B2NOTE EUDAT ltd & BSC B2SHARE B2SHARE is the EUDAT user-friendly, reliable and trustworthy service for researchers, scientific communities and citizen scientists to store and publish finalized static research data from diverse contexts. B2SHARE maintains small and medium sized research objects by itself, but it can also be used to register and publish information about larger data objects locating in other storage services. EUDAT ltd & CSC Data Privacy Statement B2SHARE JSC Community instance of B2SHARE offered by Jülich Supercomputing Centre to Forschungszentrum Jülich and related communities. Juelich SC Data Privacy Statement B2SHARE JSC test Testing community instance of B2SHARE offered by Jülich Supercomputing Centre to Forschungszentrum Jülich and related communities. This instance is only for testing purpose. It does not provide PIDs and long term preservation. Juelich SC Data Privacy Statement B2SHARE stress test Non public instance of B2SHARE used for stress testing. CSC Data Privacy Statement B2SHARE test Non public instance of B2SHARE used for tests of new features and versions. CSC Data Privacy Statement B2SHARE training Training instance of EUDAT B2SHARE B2SHARE is the EUDAT user-friendly, reliable and trustworthy service for researchers, scientific communities and citizen scientists to store and publish finalized static research data from diverse contexts. B2SHARE maintain small and medium sized research objects by itself, but it can also be used to register and publish information about larger data objects locating in other storage services. EUDAT ltd & CSC Data Privacy Statement DPM DPM is a tool that provides data policy management functionality. It can be used by data managers to define data policies, store them and share them with the data service providers, who will enforce them; service integrators to integrate a third-party service with the DPM relying on the XML DB API; B2SAFE service administrators to have a view on the policies defined by a community data manager -They can download and enforce them and provide feedback to the data managers. EUDAT ltd & SIGMA2 Data Privacy Statement DPMT The DPMT is EUDAT CDIs e-Infrastructure registry for managing and distributing information about service providers, the providers' service and resource offers, the actually provided service instances (RegisteredServices) and the related service components (RegisteredServiceComponents). It obtains information about products offered by EUDAT from the EUDAT Service Catalog that is managed via the EUDAT Service Portfolio Management Tool (SPMT). The DPMT compise a customer management data base in that the CDI customers (organisations and representing persons) and their business cases (data projects) are registered. The accounted usage of storage and compute resources are mapped to the data projects. EUDAT ltd & MPCDF Data Privacy Statement EasyDMP EASYDMP is a service that simplifies the task of creating data management plans. SIGMA2 Data Privacy Statement EDUUNI Eduuni is a collaboration service environment for flexible and secure collaboration across organisation and ecosystem boundaries. It is hosting the CDI confluence wiki and the CDI Jira ticketing system. EDUUNI via CSC Data Privacy Statement CDI GitLab CDI GitLab is EUDATs software repository. EUDAT ltd & KIT Data Privacy Statement CDI Helpdesk helpdesk.eudat.eu, service providing the helpdesk to all EUDAT services EUDAT ltd & BSC HTTP API BSC BSC HTTP API CINECA The B2STAGE service allows data staging, i.e. data transfer into and out of EUDAT data nodes. Data staged into EUDAT are assigned a unique Persistent Identified (PID). The HTTP APIs allow for access to both data and metadata stored into B2SAFE. CINECA Data Privacy Statement HTTP API MPCDF The B2STAGE service at MPCDF MPCDF Poem This service is used in order to define checks (probes) and associate them to service types. Each grouping of checks and service types forms a POEM profile. EUDAT ltd & GRNET Poem SDC This service is used in order to define checks (probes) and associate them to service types. Each grouping of checks and service types forms a POEM profile. EUDAT ltd & GRNET SDC Demo CDI SPMT The Service Portfolio/Catalogue Management Tool (SPMT) manages definitions of the different classes of services and service components and is designed following the FitSM service portfolio management process. EUDAT ltd & GRNET Data Privacy Statement CDI SVMON SVMON is a service that collects information on software version, stores and displays collections in a compact view. SVMON also uniquely provides information of service attributes. EUDAT ltd & KIT Data Privacy Statement WaTTS The service WaTTS is a Token Translation Service (TTS) that provides a layer where identities, enrollment, group membership and other attributes and authorization policies on distributed resources can be managed in an homogeneous way. KIT Data Privacy Statement WaTTS dev The service WaTTS is a Token Translation Service (TTS) that provides a layer where identities, enrollment, group membership and other attributes and authorization policies on distributed resources can be managed in an homogeneous way. KIT Data Privacy Statement External services integrated with B2ACCESS Service Service Description Provider Privacy Statement DIRAC 4 EGI EGI Check-in The EGI Check-in service enables the registration and management of virtual organisations and their members in order to provide users with access to services that are available in the context of the virtual organisation(s) they belong to. EGI foundation & GRNET Data Privacy Statement EGI Datahub DataHub - a production instance of Onedata for the purpose of integrating with services offered by EGI. EGI Foundation & Cyfronet EOSC portal The EOSC portal provides an overview to all services offered within the EOSC. Cyfronet Data Privacy Statement EOSC Hub portal EOSC-hub brings together multiple service providers to create the Hub: a single contact point for European researchers and innovators to discover, access, use and reuse a broad spectrum of resources for advanced data-driven research. The project mobilises providers from the EGI Federation, EUDAT CDI, INDIGO-DataCloud and other major European research infrastructures to deliver a common catalogue of research data, services and software for research. Trust-IT Data Privacy Statement GOCDB SDC GOCDB is the main topology registry of SeaDataCloud. It is a flexible service registry which can hold information about the services provided by the infrastructure. EGI Foundation & STFC Data Privacy Statement GeoFon The EIDA Authentication Service (EAS) offers EIDA/EPOS-S users a web page to request a digitally signed "token", which they can use at all EIDA services. This token must be used in the case that the user would like to request embargoed data. Its use is optional only when requesting open data, but by using it we can offer them other options which are not available for anonymous users. GFZ Data Privacy Statement Open AiiDA Lab The AiiDA lab aims to provide access to key computational materials science capabilities through an intuitive user interface that does not require expertise in the underlying codes or programming languages. EPFL Data Privacy Statement
